findings.description: The `recvfrom` call at the end doesn't validate the received data size properly.
The `atoi()` function doesn't check for integer overflow conditions.
`atoi()` returns 0 for invalid input without error indication.
No validation of user input before conversion to integers.
Socket not properly closed on exit paths.
Several function calls don't properly check return values.
